sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Caldera Transit will pilot Wayline at two Singapore facilities. The customer has selected the Singapore service region and the Standard support plan.

sections.heading: Decisions
paragraphs: Use email alerts during the first week. Trial webhooks in the sandbox after the customer's endpoint finishes security review. Keep the data import to a single synthetic trip for the first operator walkthrough.

sections.heading: Actions
paragraphs: Nadia Rahim will provision the sandbox by 23 October. The customer will provide the site roster and installation dates by 28 October. Customer Enablement will schedule the first review after seven days of live readings.
